summary: Ocean Capital Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $100 million in gross proceeds, plus full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option for an additional 1,500,000 units ($15 million). Each unit consists of one ordinary share, one right entitling the holder to receive one ordinary share upon a future business combination, and one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The company entered into an underwriting agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners and a warrant agreement. This is a routine IPO closing, not a special situation; watch for future business combination announcement.
